additional_info.body:
Dear Nadeem, good afternoon. I hope you are doing well.
The error is related to a communication error with the charging controller. From my side, without any trained technician, I can only recommend restarting the charger but
be aware that if the component is not working properly, the 2nd outlet might also be rendered useless
.
From my side, I can only request support from the regional colleagues to help on this task.
Let me know what's best for you before I proceed.
Best regards,
Francisco
